fields.value: Senior Business Analyst with 14+ years of experience across Payments, Banking Operations, Reconciliation and Financial Services, with strong experience in payment transformation and operating-model change. Experienced in assessing current-state payment operations, identifying process, control and operational gaps, and supporting the design and implementation of target-state operating-model changes across People, Process and Technology for ISO 20022 and payment-modernization initiatives. Strong experience translating AS-IS findings into TO-BE processes, business requirements, process flows, business rules, implementation requirements and delivery artefacts. Deep domain expertise in SWIFT MT/MX, ISO 20022, CBPR+, cross-border payments, payment processing, clearing, settlement, reconciliation and investigations, with experience working across Business, Operations, Technology, QA, Compliance and client stakeholders. Experienced across the change lifecycle from current-state assessment and target-state process definition through UAT, implementation support, production sign-off and operational control readiness.
